nodes.label: Data Contract
nodes.author: santifer
nodes.rationale: Separates user-owned files (cv.md, profile.yml, _profile.md, etc.) from system-layer files (modes, scripts, templates) so that auto-updates never overwrite personal data. The rule is enforced by forbidding user-specific content in system-layer files.

nodes.label: Governance Model (BDFL)
nodes.author: santifer
nodes.rationale: BDFL model chosen to keep architecture decisions (CLAUDE.md, scoring, data contract) under single maintainer control while still allowing community contributions through a defined contributor ladder.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-Loop Principle
nodes.author: santifer
nodes.rationale: The system never auto-submits applications to protect both the user's reputation and recruiters' time. Low-fit offers (below 4.0/5) are explicitly recommended against to maintain quality over quantity.

nodes.label: Unicode Normalization — ATS Compatibility Pass
nodes.rationale: Em-dashes, curly quotes, ellipsis, zero-width spaces, and non-breaking spaces cause parsing errors or display issues in ATS systems and legacy parsers. generate-pdf.mjs applies a normalization pass to convert these to ASCII-safe equivalents.

nodes.label: language.modes_dir Config Convention
nodes.rationale: The language.modes_dir field in config/profile.yml is a convention (not a hard-coded schema flag) that tells Claude which localized modes directory to use permanently. It was designed this way to avoid a code-level language switch, keeping the system language-agnostic at the tooling layer while supporting locale-specific mode files.

nodes.label: 6-Archetype Classification System
nodes.rationale: The 6 archetypes (AI Platform/LLMOps, Agentic Workflows, Technical AI PM, AI Solutions Architect, AI Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Transformation Lead) are the same across all language variants. They are intentionally shared and not language-localized, because archetype classification drives proof-point prioritization, summary framing, and STAR story selection uniformly regardless of market.

nodes.label: STAR+R Story Framework (Situation Task Action Result Reflection)
nodes.rationale: The Reflection column in STAR+R was added deliberately to signal seniority: junior candidates describe what happened, senior candidates extract lessons. This design choice is replicated identically across all language variants (FR, PT, JA, RU, DE, EN) because it is a universal signal.
nodes.norm_label: star+r story framework (situation task action result reflection)

nodes.label: TSV Tracker Additions Pattern
nodes.rationale: The TSV-based tracker addition workflow (write to batch/tracker-additions/, then merge via merge-tracker.mjs) was designed to avoid merge conflicts and duplication when multiple agents or evaluations run in parallel. Direct edits to applications.md are only permitted for updating existing entries.

nodes.label: Playwright Single-Instance Constraint
nodes.rationale: All language variants explicitly forbid launching 2+ parallel agents using Playwright because they share the same browser instance. This constraint is documented in every _shared.md to ensure it is visible to all language-mode users.

nodes.label: No-Hardcode Proof Points Rule
nodes.rationale: Metrics must always be read from cv.md and article-digest.md at evaluation time rather than hardcoded in mode files. This rule appears in every _shared.md across all languages to prevent stale data from appearing in evaluations.
